dominant_breach: collection lawsuits converting disputed or stale debt into enforceable judgment tails

fresh_start_capacity_gate.note: Debt collection is a fresh-start problem when lawsuit, default, renewal, interest, lien, and credit/report tails outlive the original shock.

debt_collection_litigation_due_process.note: FDCPA enforcement and complaint data must be joined to court-level proof of service, standing, documentation, default rate, and answer assistance.

default_judgment_repair.note: Still needs jurisdiction-level data on motions to vacate, service defects, default rates, and restoration timing.

post_judgment_interest_and_renewal.note: Judgment renewal and interest tails can convert temporary distress into durable wealth extraction; source-fit requires state-level rules.

service_of_process_quality.note: A default judgment should not certify unless service quality and defendant notice are proven for ordinary claimants, not only presumed from docket status.

collection_lawsuit_proof_standards.note: Standing, chain-of-title, limitations, affidavit quality, and itemized debt proof must be scored before judgment finality is treated as legitimate.

proof_debt: court-level default rate, answer rate, and representation rate
post-judgment interest, renewal, lien, and reporting tail
proof standards for debt buyers and mass collection firms

gate_18_fresh_start_capacity.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the scoreboard proves claim conversion, notice, timing, legal aid or administrative capacity, vendor/report suppression where relevant, and subgroup outcomes at the actual threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.question: motion-to-vacate access and timing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track whether defendants learn of judgments before garnishment/levy and whether courts restore status quickly enough to preserve threshold assets.

evidence_debt_register.question: post-judgment interest, renewal, lien, and reporting tail
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Build state-law table for interest, renewal periods, lien duration, revival, and credit/report persistence.

evidence_debt_register.question: proof standards for debt buyers and mass collection firms
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Audit chain-of-title, account documentation, limitations defenses, arbitration clauses, and affidavit reliability by plaintiff type.

remedy_operability_register.harm_or_claim: Default judgment converts debt into long-term garnishment, lien, and record tail
remedy_operability_register.claimant_perimeter: Defendants in collection cases, especially unrepresented consumers and debt-buyer defendants
remedy_operability_register.standing_path: Answer, motion to vacate, FDCPA/FCRA complaint, state UDAP or court-rule remedy
remedy_operability_register.notice_explanation: Service and complaint must explain plaintiff standing, debt proof, limitations, and consequences of default
remedy_operability_register.interim_protection: Automatic stay of enforcement while defective service/proof is challenged
remedy_operability_register.time_to_relief: Before garnishment, levy, lien attachment, license/job/housing denial, or judgment renewal
remedy_operability_register.review_body: State court, small claims/civil division, consumer regulator, attorney general
remedy_operability_register.collective_or_representative_action: Legal aid, court navigators, pattern-practice enforcement, and class/representative actions where available
remedy_operability_register.restoration_remedy: Vacatur, dismissal, reduced judgment, restitution, fee shifting, lien release, report correction
remedy_operability_register.enforcement_actor: State courts, CFPB/FTC/state AGs, court administrators
